app.takenOver: Hearth was opened in another tab, which now owns the local database.
app.storageIntro: Hearth could not open its on-device database, so anything you import now would be lost on reload. Usually another Hearth tab still holds the storage: close it and retry. Private windows and some browsers do not offer persistent storage at all.
app.archiveBanner: Archive opened in memory. Nothing is stored in this browser; changes are kept only if you save a new archive from Settings.
app.memoryBanner: Not saving: this session runs in memory and everything disappears on reload. Export a dump from Settings before closing.
app.archiveHint: Enter the passphrase it was saved with. Nothing is stored in this browser.
